SELECT ai.id, ai.type, ai.card_id, ai.text, ai.sender, ai.history_id, ai.send_time AS send_time,
-- card_info fields aci.id AS card_id, aci.title AS title, aci.video_url AS video_url, aci.analysis_id AS analysis_id,
-- AIAnalysisInfo fields aai.overall_score AS overall_score, aai.stability_score AS stability_score, aai.fluency_score AS fluency_score, aai.proficiency_score AS proficiency_score, aai.stability_improvement AS stability_improvement, aai.proficiency_enhancement AS proficiency_enhancement, aai.fluency_promotion AS fluency_promotion, aai.general_advice AS general_advice, aai.self_left_x_data AS self_left_x_data, aai.self_left_y_data AS self_left_y_data, aai.self_right_x_data AS self_right_x_data, aai.self_right_y_data AS self_right_y_data, aai.motion_name AS motion_name, aai.task_id AS task_id, aai.task_status AS task_status
FROM ai_content_info ai LEFT JOIN ai_card_info aci ON ai.card_id = aci.id AND ai.type = 'card' LEFT JOIN ai_analysis_result aai ON aci.analysis_id = aai.id WHERE ai.history_id = #{historyId}

SELECT aai.id AS analysis_id, aai.overall_score, aai.stability_score, aai.fluency_score, aai.proficiency_score, aai.stability_improvement, aai.proficiency_enhancement, aai.fluency_promotion, aai.general_advice, aai.self_left_x_data, aai.self_left_y_data, aai.self_right_x_data, aai.self_right_y_data, aai.motion_name, aai.task_id, aai.task_status FROM ai_content_info ai LEFT JOIN ai_card_info aci ON ai.card_id = aci.id LEFT JOIN ai_analysis_result aai ON aci.analysis_id = aai.id WHERE ai.history_id = #{historyId} AND ai.type = 'card'
